description.value: Penguin Ice Cream is a lively dessert and quick-service food shop on Wellington Avenue in Chilliwack, serving premium slow-churned ice cream and Italian-style gelato in an extensive lineup of flavours. Beyond frozen treats, the menu spans hand-spun shakes, smoothies, burgers, poutine, and Indian-inspired sides like samosa, spring rolls, and gulab jamun with ice cream. It makes for a satisfying and eclectic mid-ride stop for cyclists passing through the Fraser Valley.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at penguinicecream.ca successfully loaded and is clearly an active, operating business at 45881 Wellington Ave, Chilliwack, BC V2P 2C8 — matching the OSM address. The website provides the phone number (+1 604-392-7234) and email not in OSM. Dairy-free gelato (Chocolate Dairy-Free) and Mango Sorbet are explicitly listed on the ice cream menu, confirming vegan-friendly options; no evidence for bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or other cyclist amenities appears anywhere on the site.
concerns: OSM record contains no phone number; phone sourced from website only.
Website homepage displays hours text that conflicts with the footer hours shown on all subpages — possible copy error on the site.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active, publicly accessible food and drink business with a live website, confirmed address, and a full menu — a useful stop for touring cyclists in Chilliwack.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Website explicitly lists 'Chocolate Dairy Free' gelato and 'Mango Sorbet' as menu items; samosa and spring roll sides are also listed

wow_evidence: premium slow-churned ice cream and Italian-style gelato in an extensive lineup of flavours
